picks.excerpt: Claude reliably renders the happy path and skips empty, loading and error states, because its training data is mostly polished marketing screenshots. The post proposes prompting and review habits that force the missing states back into AI-generated screens.
picks.rationale: Names the exact failure mode of AI-generated screens — no empty, loading or error states — and gives a review habit a designer can apply on the next handoff.

picks.excerpt: Learn how Figma to Claude Code works, where it adds real value, and where it falls short. A practical guide to design-to-code workflows, use cases, and limitations.
picks.rationale: An agency field report on where the Figma-to-Claude-Code path actually pays off and where it breaks — the limits, not the demo.

picks.excerpt: FabricatorStudio released Armature, a free standalone tool that auto-rigs and skins 3D characters and exports USD for Maya, Unreal Engine and Blender. Optional control-rig generation is available for Maya users.
picks.rationale: A free, standalone auto-rigger with USD export drops a paid, hours-long step out of the 3D character pipeline today.

picks.excerpt: Thirty live sites, including major design systems, were scored against a 40-check machine-readable design contract covering spacing, type scale, contrast and state coverage. The results show where even mature systems fail an automated audit.
picks.rationale: Turns 'is our design system consistent?' into a 40-check machine-readable contract, with scored evidence that mature systems still fail it.

picks.excerpt: Our series Inside XR Design examines specific examples of great XR design. Today we're looking at the game Electronauts and what it can teach us about smart VR interface design.
picks.rationale: A teardown of the spatial interface basics every XR prototype keeps getting wrong — reach zones, affordances, and hand-first controls.
